sentences.en: Our company uses a digital system for managing projects.
sentences.zh: 我们公司用一个数字系统来管理项目。

sentences.en: The hospital has switched to a new digital system for patient records.
sentences.zh: 医院换了一个新的数字系统来记录病人信息。

sentences.en: We can access the digital system from anywhere using our smartphones.
sentences.zh: 我们可以通过智能手机从任何地方访问这个数字系统。
